title: Zainab Binte Ali
body:
Aqeelatul Arab
x8
Ay munkaro nakir sunlo meri sada tum ko nahi pataa zainab ka hun fakir
Yeh Kabr nahi hain uskaa hai aza khana jo bint-e-Murtaza hai Shabbir ki hamshir
<<MINI>>
Zainab binte Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
x8
1. Ay nakirayn sawaalo ki na bharwar karo, Farshe majlis hai yahan awo adab se betho
Sheh ki majlis ho bapa hukm dete hai yahi
<<MINI>>
Zainab binte Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
x8
2. Tum bhi aate the dar-e-binte Ali pe aksar
Sajda-e-shukr kiya maine bhi us chowkhat par
Jab bhi sajde me jabeen mein bhi kehta tha yahi
<<MINI>>
Zainab binte Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
x8
3. Kon hai maula mera tum ko batata hu abhi
Aawo betho tumhe talkeen sunata hu abhi
Kya tumhe yaad nahi hai madadghar meri
<<MINI>>
Zainab binte Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
x8
4. Daagh-e-matam jo hai tehrir mere sine par
Saath aaya hai mere mera hawala bankar
Haan kafan par bhi mere ye ibarat hai likhi
<<MINI>>
Zainab binte Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
x8
5. Tum ko batalatu hu me ashk azaa ki qimat
Ek aansoo ki barabar nahi baagh-e-jannat
Rone waalo ke liye parti hai nade ali
<<MINI>>
Zainab binte Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
x8
6. Sunke ye baat nakirayn ne khaalik se kahaa
Ai khuda banda-e-zainab hai ye banda tera
Kya sawaal isse kare iske lab par hai abhi
<<MINI>>
Zainab binte Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
x8
7. Hum sawaalat ke khatir to nahi aate hai
Khayriyat puch ke momin ki chale jate hai
Khuch nahi keh te use jiske zamin ho bani
<<MINI>>
Zainab binte Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
x8
8. Phir nakirayn ne aapas me ye tey kar ke kaha
Chor do sare sawaalaat sunawo nawha
Per musalsal ye sadaa kabr se aati rahi
<<MINI>>
Zainab binte Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
x8
9. Ay nakirayn wo Abbas-e-Ali ki Khwahar
Majma-e-ahle sitam mei ye pukari ro ker
me wohi bibi hun Jisko kehte hai nabi
<<MINI>>
Zainab binte Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
x8
10. Baad
Darvaish
ne
<<DIVIDER>>
Rehan
ye saabit ker di
Kabr me unse sawaalat nakirayn kabhi
aake Karde gi nahi jise bhi ho razi
<<MINI>>
Zainab binte Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
x8
